name: geoShake
description: Mirrors Geometry Dash Shake Triggers to controller and phone vibration.

controller-vibration.name: Controller vibration
controller-vibration.description: Send Shake Trigger strength and duration to every connected controller.

phone-vibration.name: Phone vibration
phone-vibration.description: Mirror Shake Triggers through the phone haptic motor on Android and iOS.

phone-duration-only.name: Cocos-style phone vibration
phone-duration-only.description: Use duration-only vibration on Android or one system vibration on iOS. Overrides the Android method toggles. Requires Phone vibration. Positive haptic strength does not change intensity; zero still mutes vibration.

android-modern-vibration.name: Modern Android vibration
android-modern-vibration.description: Use vibration effects with intensity control on Android. If both methods are enabled, modern vibration is tried first. Requires Phone vibration.

android-legacy-vibration.name: Legacy Android vibration
android-legacy-vibration.description: Allow duration-only Android vibration when modern vibration is disabled or fails. Disable modern vibration to force this method. Requires Phone vibration.

vibrator-debug.name: Vibrator diagnostics
vibrator-debug.description: Check Android vibrator access, hardware, intensity support and permission without vibrating. Also writes the report to the Geode log. Available even when phone vibration is disabled.

vibration-test.name: Vibration test
vibration-test.description: Send a half-second test pulse to enabled devices using the saved haptic strength. Apply setting changes before testing. iOS produces a single impact.

strength-scale.name: Haptic strength
strength-scale.description: Scale the trigger's shake strength before sending it to haptics.
